findings.title: Mutable default argument in constructor
findings.detail: Using a mutable list as default argument causes all ShoppingCart instances to share the same items list when no argument is provided, leading to data corruption
findings.recommendation: Change to `def __init__(self, items=None): self.items = items if items is not None else []`

findings.title: Potential division by zero in average_item_price
findings.detail: Calling average_item_price() on an empty cart will raise ZeroDivisionError, crashing the application
findings.recommendation: Add check: `if not self.items: return 0.0` before the division

findings.title: Missing input validation in add_item method
findings.detail: No validation for negative prices, negative quantities, or empty names allows invalid data into the cart
findings.recommendation: Add validation: check price > 0, qty > 0, and name is non-empty string

findings.title: Potential None reference in checkout function
findings.detail: If user parameter is None, accessing user.name will raise AttributeError
findings.recommendation: Add null check: `if user is None: raise ValueError("User cannot be None")`

findings.title: Floating-point arithmetic for monetary calculations
findings.detail: Using float for money calculations can lead to rounding errors and precision loss
findings.recommendation: Use Decimal type for monetary values or work with integers (cents)

findings.title: Unsafe coupon application without validation
findings.detail: No validation on coupon parameter (could be None) or coupon percentage (could be negative or >100)
findings.recommendation: Add validation for coupon existence and percentage range (0-100)

findings.title: Potential None return from find_item not handled by callers
findings.detail: find_item returns None when item not found, but callers might not check for None before accessing the result
findings.recommendation: Consider raising an exception for not found items or document the None return clearly

suggested_tests.title: Test mutable default argument isolation
suggested_tests.rationale: Ensure cart instances don't share items list due to mutable default argument

scenario.name: Cart instances should have independent item lists
steps: Given two shopping carts created with default constructor
When adding an item to the first cart
Then the second cart should remain empty

suggested_tests.pytest_skeleton:
def test_cart_instance_isolation():
    cart1 = ShoppingCart()
    cart2 = ShoppingCart()
    cart1.add_item("test", 10, 1)
    assert len(cart2.items) == 0
